source_title: BIS Working Paper No. 1270 - Stablecoins and safe-asset prices
exact_passage: a $3.5 billion (2-standard deviation) inflow lowers 3-month Treasury bill yields by 0.71 basis points on impact, and up to 4 basis points within 10 days
scope_limits: 3-month T-bills only; no spillovers to longer maturities found
confounding_note: This yield impact is consistent with BOTH net demand (new money) and substitution (existing T-bill holders shifting to stablecoins). The directional reading (stablecoins lower yields) is compatible with the KC Fed's substitution model, not necessarily evidence of incremental demand.
